rationale: Wing Chuen Lam's robotics and automation expertise at The Robot Works could complement Sharon's work building AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai, particularly as physical robotics systems increasingly require intelligent agent coordination. While their domains operate in different layers—mechanical systems versus agentic AI—there's potential to explore how AI agents could enhance robotic decision-making and autonomy in production environments.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet Sharon — you're both working at the intersection of advanced systems (robotics automation and production-ready AI agents) and might find common ground on how intelligent systems can be integrated.
